Q: Can anyone tell me how I could do this? A:

You used the playwright tag which already includes Test Agents, healing agents and Coding agents. The test agents only work for Node.js but, after all, Playwright itself is a Node.js library with Python, .NET and Java wrappers.

Q: Python Libraries Issue A:

Sounds like user error. Pip generally will put things where you need it. How are you installing your libs? (And do you mean numpy?)

Q: M4a (mp4) audio file encoded with pydub+ffmpeg doesn't play on Android A:

from pydub import AudioSegment, effects

inp = "/mnt/data/‎⁨محاضره جده اماني  Drugs affecting the endocrine systems⁩.m4a"

audio = AudioSegment.from_file(inp)

enhanced = effects.normalize(audio)

out = "/mnt/data/محاضرة_محسنة.m4a"

enhanced.export(out, format="ipod")  # m4a

print(out)

Q: Seeking advice on audio-to-audio alignment for Remix/Original MV lip-syncing A:

Quite simply... you need to sit down with some video editing software and line things up the way you want to see it.

This isn't a technical problem. While you could probably whip something up to make this job easier, there will still be manual editing that you'll want to do, if anything for stylistic reasons.
